name: LuciD VR Web Browser
summary:
LuciD VR Web Browser brings the full web to your headset.

BROWSER EXTENSIONS
Install add-ons from addons.mozilla.org right inside the browser: ad blockers, dark mode, video tools and many more. Turn them on and off, open their panels and settings from one menu.

VIDEOS IN 3D
